title: Prove whole-word BIT scalar cuts and least-price island repairs
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

130 exact directed chart cuts exclude 2,872 of the native 2,873 nonbridge deletions with the other incidences and public endpoints unchanged. Arbitrary surviving recoding and clocks are allowed. The only deletion outside this result is 3410. For each of 48 named island topologies, the cheapest residual augmentation restores relaxed capacity at the cost of one grade four (45) or one grade five (3). Even allowing arbitrarily many paid legal contacts leaves the best complete BIT upper margin below `−71.8343339161046255`.

## Task and overlap

Refined #7852 follow-up on main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, toolkit `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`, and native comparator #7830 at `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`. This extends #7995 `aa8ddf1f20caf6e56398d858934cc4a62f5570d9` at the incidence boundary. Separate comparator replay #7973 `ac3df5d5c8889f464f575e32dfea43714abf08ca`. The 49th chart-388 topology uses a static cut only.

## Validation

Both inner manifests and independent `python3 -I -B verify.py` cold checks passed, including both literal native orientations, 48 integral flow/path/dual witnesses, 50,520 route nestings, signed margins at both trial rates and corruption checks.

## Open next questions

The cuts leave 3410, other surviving endpoint retargets and changed productive endpoints open. A capacity witness alone cannot qualify a new caller.
